paper_metadata.title: A 3.3-V ISDN U-Interface Line Driver With a New IQ-Control Circuit
paper_metadata.abstract: In this brief, we propose a new quiescent current Q) control circuit applicable to line drivers for digital subscriber ( line (DSL) applications. The line driver consists of pre-amplifier, error amplifiers, output transistors, and Q control circuits. A new method is proposed for controlling Q values in order to obtain high linearity performance. It also helps to determine the minimum off-current value of the class-AB output stage to reduce crossover distortion. The line driver is implemented for ISDN U-interface applications. It is fabricated in a 0.35m CMOS technology for a single power supply voltage of 3.3 V, and a total harmonic distortion of less than 64 dB is achieved.
